en.headline: West Kowloon traffic police arrest two in illegal hire-car sting
en.dek: Undercover officers posing as passengers booked two private cars via online platforms; both drivers face charges of using vehicles for hire without a permit and without third-party insurance.
body: Officers from the West Kowloon Traffic Enforcement and Control special duty team conducted an operation against illegal hire cars, commonly known as white-plate cars, on Thursday.

Posing as passengers, the officers booked two private cars through online platforms for journeys within the Yau Tsim district. When the vehicles arrived at their destinations, the cars were found to lack valid hire-car permits.

Two local men aged 46 and 43 were arrested on suspicion of driving a vehicle for hire or reward without a permit and using a vehicle without third-party insurance. Both were released on bail pending further inquiries and the vehicles were seized for examination.

Under the Road Traffic Ordinance, a first conviction for using a vehicle for hire without a permit can attract a fine of HK$10,000 and six months’ imprisonment; a subsequent offence carries a fine of HK$25,000 and 12 months’ imprisonment. Police urged the public to use only licensed public transport.

zh.headline: 西九龍交警放蛇打擊白牌車 兩本地司機被捕
zh.dek: 人員喬裝乘客透過網上平台租用兩輛私家車，因車輛沒有有效出租汽車許可證，拘捕兩名46歲及43歲本地男司機，兩人獲准保釋候查。
body: 西九龍總區交通部執行及管制組特遣隊今日進行打擊非法載客取酬（俗稱白牌車）的執法行動。
人員喬裝乘客並透過網上平台租用兩輛私家車，分別前往油尖區內不同地點。當車輛抵達目的地時，因涉案車輛並沒有有效的出租汽車許可證，人員以涉嫌非法駕駛汽車作出租或載客取酬用途及沒有第三者保險而使用車輛，拘捕兩名分別46歲及43歲的本地男司機。
兩人均獲准保釋候查，有關車輛亦已被扣查作進一步檢驗。
根據《道路交通條例》，除非汽車獲發有效的出租汽車許可證，否則任何人不得駕駛或使用車輛作出租或載客取酬之用。首次定罪可被判處罰款一萬元及監禁六個月，再次干犯者則可被判處罰款二萬五千元及監禁十二個月。警方呼籲市民出行時應選擇合法的公共交通工具。
